dependencies: Desktop: Snapmaker Orca's own deps prefix (deps/build/destdir/usr/local in the local checkout), built by its deps/ superbuild. Android: orcaslicer-android-engine's NDK prefix (engine/ENGINE_PIN.json archives) with GMP 6.2.1 rebuilt with --enable-cxx (engine/snapmaker/android/prepare_engine_root.sh). Web: the browser prefix from engine/wasm/scripts/build_deps.sh, GMP likewise with C++ classes.

platforms.android: moved 2026-09-27, default (engine/snapmaker/android/prepare_engine_root.sh, then Gradle's default -PnozzleEngine=snapmaker; -PnozzleEngine=upstream still builds engine/ENGINE_PIN.json's upstream OrcaSlicer 824b216f). Not yet run on a device. See docs/upstream/PROVENANCE.md P-0010.
platforms.web: moved 2026-09-27, default (engine/wasm/scripts/build_engine_snapmaker.sh, INSTALL=1 puts it in web/public/engine; engine/wasm/scripts/build_engine.sh still builds the upstream 824b216f engine). See P-0010.
